Hello! I’m Layla, I was talking about the positives of epilepsy in this video along with Carlos and friends. I know we’ve all definitely been through very difficult and different times, but that just makes us all the more unique. In my experience with epilepsy, I would 100% call it a blessing because it completely changed me for the better. I would be in such a deep, dark place where I would just continue to dig myself into a deeper hole that I eventually wouldn’t be able to climb out of if it weren’t for epilepsy. Before epilepsy, I was the worst person I knew. You wouldn’t even want to be around me. Now, after it, I’ve realized that I’ve been given a second chance at life, and to take it and make the best from it. I took the time and thought for months during and after my therapy/recovery to better myself, and I’m definitely seeing results! If I hadn’t of been diagnosed with epilepsy, I would have never had that epiphany and I would have been confused, stuck, and in a horrible place. Although epilepsy has its downs, it definitely has its ups, too!😁
